summary: AUDIT-ONLY (no source changes). Collected via live APIs under ent_ksc with independent pymongo recompute. Found several NUMBER DISCREPANCIES (home AR vs AR Aging; bank saldo ignores opening_balance; vendor_bills paid overshoots total; leaderboard total exceeds entity-scoped SO sum; monthly SO per-sales = 0 but target shown; 22/24 ent_ksc SOs have no sales_id). ROLE MENUS: md@kainnusantara.id DOES NOT EXIST in users (0 users with role='md') — spec cannot be verified. warehouse@ sees all expected Gudang items incl. RFID (3 tabs, no Perangkat) + Eskalasi Gudang + Antar Entitas (Grup) ✓. salesadmin@ sees Meja Admin Sales standalone + Antar Entitas (Grup) ✓. FORMS: Transaksi Kas modal still has 3 native <select> (iter146 regression — not fixed) and dialog width ~1880px (unconstrained). Other 4 forms look clean.

critical.issue: AR outstanding mismatch: /api/home/admin ar.outstanding=468,874,760.5 but /api/ar/aging totals.total=442,999,760.5 (Δ 25,875,000.00 = exactly the ent_kanda SO 'reserved' row 25,875,000). /api/home/admin appears to include cross-entity SOs (leaderboard-style) while /api/ar/aging is entity-scoped. Same card label shows two different numbers.

With X-Entity-Id=ent_ksc the leaderboard sums total_sales=542,873,160.5 across sales_users, but DB sum of all SO.total_amount for ent_ksc = 457,205,550 (Δ 85,667,610.5). Includes ent_kanda SOs (35,375,000) and still has 50M unaccounted → either multi-entity leak OR double counting (e.g. special_orders joined). Entity scoping likely broken.

Saldo per rekening IGNORES bank_accounts.opening_balance. kas_kecil balance returned 7,750,000 (= 10,000,000 in - 2,250,000 out) but expected 9,750,000 (+ opening 2,000,000). bank_bca_ksc expected 34,987,800 (opening 50M + in 12.46M - out 27.47M). Any card showing 'Saldo Kas Kecil / Kas Besar' underreports opening balances.

For 3 'paid' bills: Σtotal_amount = 27,750,000 but Σamount_paid = 30,802,500 (paid > total by 3,052,500). Either seed is wrong (bills paid > billed) or amount_paid double-aggregated from cash_transactions. Any 'Dibayar / Terbayar' KPI will be incorrect.

target.amount=0 and achievement_pct=0 for user_sales_01 whose sales_targets record exists (period 2026-10, target_sales_amount=250,000,000). The target lookup appears to only check target_collection_amount OR filters by sales_id vs user id mismatch. Monthly target card shows 0 while targets table shows 250M.

22 of 24 ent_ksc SOs have NO `sales_id` field; leaderboard/outstanding-per-sales must be falling back to customer.assigned_sales_id, which can misattribute reassigned customers. Also monthly SO-per-sales aggregation on sales_user_id returns [] (field doesn't exist on any SO). Impacts 'outstanding customer dari sales person' and MTD sales per sales.

7 cash_transactions (sum 63.74M in + 3.33M out) have NO account_id. They are still bucketed by `cash_type` in summary → saldo for a specific rekening cannot be reconstructed; group_cash view and bank_reconciliation will show gaps.

prod_batik_mega totals.atp_qty = -234 while available 310 + incoming 800 - reserved 496.03 - committed 87 = +526.97. ATP formula in dashboard totals seems to double-subtract reservations or miscount quarantine (80) + committed. Negative ATP displayed to user is suspect.

User role 'md' not in DB (users.distinct('role') = admin, designer, driver, finance, manager, sales, sales_admin, warehouse). md@kainnusantara.id login fails ('Email atau password tidak sesuai'). Spec requires MD-specific Meja MD + menu checks — impossible to verify.

collections sales_invoices, ar_payments, customer_payments all empty but AR Aging + /api/home/admin collected_mtd=756,500 and overdue=5,571,200 are non-zero. AR is derived purely from sales_orders fields (no invoice ledger). This conflates 'penjualan belum tertagih' with 'faktur belum dibayar' — numbers in 'Collected MTD' card and penalty_issued=49,579.56 come from a non-existent invoice ledger.

rca of the issue: Primary RCA — number mismatches are rooted in (a) MISSING invoice/payment ledgers (sales_invoices/ar_payments/customer_payments empty) which forces AR/collection numbers to be derived heuristically from sales_orders and cash_transactions, and (b) inconsistent entity scoping across routers. Reproduce: run `cd /app/backend && python tests/audit_numbers.py` after logging X-Entity-Id=ent_ksc — compare `/api/home/admin` → ar.outstanding (468,874,760.5) vs `/api/ar/aging` → totals.total (442,999,760.5); the delta 25,875,000 matches ent_kanda SO reserved=25,875,000, confirming cross-entity leak. Mitigation: introduce a single scoping decorator in backend routers that enforces X-Entity-Id; add proper invoice/payment ledgers before trusting AR/collection KPIs; seed md user via bootstrap; add opening_balance in cash summary; enforce amount_paid ≤ total_amount at vendor_bills payment write time.
